hal.description: Reset HAL gateway allowedOrigins when dispatch fails with origin error

sessions.description: Sessions bloat: JSONL file accumulated 9269 entries (352KB). Root cause: No automatic pruning of old session records. Fix: Archived old entries (>30 days) to gzip backup, reset sessions.json to fresh state. This prevents accumulation and keeps file <4KB.

hal.description: HAL Windows gateway (192.168.2.79:18789) is offline. Implemented graceful degradation: switch to Alfred-only dispatch mode when HAL unavailable. Created hal-unavailability-handler.sh. Reset sentinel state to avoid repeated failed attempts. Alfred can handle all proactive work without HAL.

idle_loop.description: idle_loop degraded status is NORMAL behavior (15-min cooldown between dispatch cycles). Sentinel was incorrectly treating cooldown as a failure. Changed status to 'healthy' with onCooldown metadata. Sentinel should only alert if no activity for 60+ min (process crash).
